failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh dry-run mode fails to detect stale heartbeat files and summary output omits 'Found' count and '--force' hint text
failures.fix: Fix sw-cleanup.sh heartbeat detection in dry-run mode to scan and display stale heartbeat entries, and ensure summary output includes 'Found N item(s)' count with '--force' hint when items are detected

failures.root_cause: sed called without -e flag in sw-code-review-test.sh, causing the substitution expression to be treated as a filename
failures.fix: Add -e flag before the substitution pattern: `sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"` instead of `sed "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"`
